name: Diagnamed Holdings Corp.
summary: Diagnamed Holdings Corp. engages in the development and commercialization of AI healthcare solutions. The company focuses on developing BRAIN AGE BRAIN HEALTH, a brain health AI platform leveraging that aims to predict and monitor brain age and provide actionable insights for mental health and neurodegenerative disorders. It has a collaboration agreement with EIREX for the development and commercialization of EIREX’s novel modular carbon-free technology that extracts hydrogen from water. Diagnamed Holdings Corp. is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
